description: Validates a JSON document and returns it pretty-printed, or returns the exact parse error with line and column. Send the raw JSON as the POST body (not as a query parameter). Returns: valid (true/false), formatted (2-space indented JSON when valid), keys (top-level key count), bytes (input size), and error (when invalid). Limits: request body up to 1 MB. Price $0.01 per call. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/json-check.
name: json-check
